candidates.change_summary: Replaced call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct call to withdraw(0) so withdrawAll transfers zero instead of full balance.
Removed onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can invoke it and cause funds to be withdrawn to the caller (owner via withdraw).
Changed onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the ownership check so only non-owners can call owner-protected functions like withdrawAll.
Replace transfer to send call that does not revert on failure (uses .call and ignores success), allowing partial or failed sends without reverting.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), so withdraw can be called by non-owners and thus change observed withdrawals.
Change call to transfer funds from low-level .call to .transfer, which reverts on failure and uses 2300 gas, altering observable behavior on sendMoney.
Replace the .call success requirement with ignoring the return value and performing no revert, making sendMoney non-reverting on failed sends and thus altering observable behavior.
Remove the restriction by changing onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), so sendMoney can be called by anyone, altering observable behavior.
